name: SquidSwap unbounded internal swap sandwiched
summary: SquidSwap's public swapTokens()/sellSwappedTokens() sell the contract's own SQUID holdings through PancakeSwap with no minimum-output check, so the attacker skewed the pool inside a PancakeV3 flash loan and sandwiched the contract's swap.
